observations: Three identical photos of a black game console, one controller, and cables.
The console is an original PlayStation 4 model, partially wrapped in plastic film.
A USB flash drive is visible, which is commonly used for the 'HEN' jailbreak on version 9.0.
A watermark 'KEVIN VIDEOS GAMES AND' is present on all images.
The seller's text claims 'fc26' is installed, which is a game that does not yet exist.

claims.evidence: The plastic wrapping obscures the surface, preventing a clear view of scratches or wear.
There is no photo of the System Information screen to confirm the firmware version.
There is no photo of the console's user interface or game library.
EA Sports FC 26 has not been released; the current version is FC 24 or FC 25.

risks.risk: Firmware is higher than 9.0 (cannot be jailbroken)
risks.proof: Screenshot of Settings > System > System Information.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard console on the latest firmware.

risks.proof: Video of a disc being inserted and the game launching.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having a broken disc drive.

risks.proof: Video of the controller being used in-game or on a test site.

proof_requests: Photo of the System Information screen showing the software version.
Photo of the Storage screen showing the HDD capacity.
Photo of the home screen showing the installed games.
Video of the console running a game to check for fan noise and disc drive functionality.
response.reason: The seller provides three identical photos and claims a game that does not exist (FC26). Verification of the firmware version and storage is required to establish the value of a jailbroken console.
